::: {.fig data-figure="layout-outline" aria-label="Emaki's window with the Outline's drawer out in color in the chat's left margin: a day's head, then an entry for every round with its time. The rest is gray. The drawer stands forward under the pointer, and the seam on its edge puts it away."}

Going back through a long session is a pain. The Outline lists every round of the chat under its day, each with its time and a short label of what came of it, written by the lightest model your session's agent has. Click an entry to scroll back to its round.

## The drawer {.i-list-bullets}

The Outline lives in the chat's left margin. Move the pointer there and a seam appears, a line down the margin with a knob halfway. Click the knob, or press [⌘⇧O]{.kbd}, and the drawer slides out, the chat moving over for it; click again to put it away. It belongs to the chat: switching to the [Agent CLI](agent-cli.qmd) folds it away, and the chat brings it back as it was.

## Summaries {.i-sparkles}

**Summarize session**, under the entries, writes a summary of the session in bullets and heads the entries with sections. **Update** brings it up to date from the new rounds alone, and **Hide** puts it away.

Each label and summary is a call to a small model of your agent's, on your account. [Settings](settings.qmd#model-calls) turns them off, which keeps the Outline without them, and chooses the model for each agent. Settings, Conversation, turns the Outline itself off.
